paragraphs: Eli Lilly and Company, doing business as Lilly, is an American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in 36 countries. Its products are marketed in approximately 90 countries. The company was founded in 1876 by Eli Lilly, a pharmaceutical chemist and Union army veteran during the American Civil War for whom the company was later named.

The company is ranked 4th on the list of largest biomedical companies by revenue and is the most valuable pharmaceutical company worldwide. It is ranked 100th on the Fortune 500 and 138th on the Forbes Global 2000. In November 2025, the company reached a $1 trillion market capitalization, the first health-care company in the world to do so.

The company's primary products are tirzepatide (Mounjaro and Zepbound) for the treatment of type 2 diabetes, weight loss, and obstructive sleep apnea (56% of 2025 revenues); abemaciclib (Verzenio) for the treatment of advanced or metastatic breast cancers (9% of 2025 revenues); dulaglutide (Trulicity) for the treatment of type 2 diabetes (7% of 2025 revenues); ixekizumab (Taltz) for the treatment of autoimmune diseases (6% of 2025 revenues); and empagliflozin (Jardiance) for the treatment of type 2 diabetes (5% of 2025 revenues). Products that have a minor contribution to revenues include Insulin lispro (Humalog), a modified type of medical insulin; ramucirumab (Cyramza), a fully human monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of cancer; baricitinib (Olumiant), an immunomodulatory medication used for the treatment of rheumatoid arthritis, alopecia areata, and COVID-19; insulin (Humulin) to treat high blood glucose; and galcanezumab (Emgality), a humanized monoclonal antibody used for the prevention of migraines. In 2024, 67% of the company's revenues came from the United States, 18% came from Europe, 3% came from Japan, and 3% came from China.

Lilly was the first company to mass-produce both the polio vaccine, developed in 1955 by Jonas Salk, and insulin. It was one of the first pharmaceutical companies to produce human insulin using recombinant DNA, including Humulin (insulin medication), Humalog (insulin lispro), and the first approved biosimilar insulin product in the US, Basaglar (insulin glargine). It achieved commercial success with major depressive disorder drugs Prozac (fluoxetine) (1986), Cymbalta (duloxetine) (2004), and its antipsychotic medication Zyprexa (olanzapine) (1996), all of which are now off patent and are manufactured by others as generic drugs. In 2005, Lilly brought exenatide to market—the first of the GLP-1 receptor agonists—followed by the GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist drugs Mounjaro and Zepbound (tirzepatide).
The Lilly Endowment, a charitable foundation organized in 1937 by the founding family, owns 9.8% of the company.

images.caption: Eli Lilly and Company. “Principal Office and Laboratories, Indianapolis, U.S.A.” Ink on paper, from the Hand Book of Pharmacy and Therapeutics. Indianapolis, Indiana, c1919.

This photo was captured at the intersection of E. McCarty St. and S. Delaware St., Indianapolis, Indiana, USA. The main building of the corporate center campus and fountain is shown in early-evening sunlight.
An 1885 photograph of Colonel Eli Lilly. American Civil War veteran, founder of Eli Lilly & co, inventor, chemist, philanthropist.

people.name: David A. Ricks
people.title: Chair, President, and Chief Executive Officer (CEO)
people.bio: Previously held various leadership roles with Lilly, including senior vice president and president, Lilly Bio-Medicines. Has 29 years of service with Lilly.
people.quote: Mr. Ricks has 29 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Adrienne Brown
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Lilly Immunology
people.bio: Previously served as group vice president of corporate business development from 2023 to 2025 and group vice president, U.S. Diabetes and Obesity from 2020 to 2023. Has 22 years of service with Lilly.
people.quote: Ms. Brown has 22 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Kenneth Custer, Ph.D.
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Lilly Cardiometabolic Health
people.bio: Previously served as president and general manager of Lilly Canada and as senior vice president and head of corporate business development. Has 17 years of service with Lilly.
people.quote: Dr. Custer has 17 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Eric Dozier
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief People Officer
people.bio: Previously held Lilly leadership roles including senior vice president, chief commercial officer for Loxo@Lilly, and vice president, global ethics and compliance officer. Has 28 years of service with Lilly.
people.quote: Mr. Dozier has 28 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Anat Hakim
people.title: Executive Vice President, General Counsel and Secretary
people.bio: Previously served as senior vice president, general counsel and secretary of WellCare from 2016 to 2018 and executive vice president, general counsel and secretary from 2018 to 2020. Earlier held litigation leadership roles at Abbott Laboratories.
people.quote: Ms. Hakim has six years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Edgardo Hernandez
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Manufacturing Operations
people.bio: Previously held Lilly leadership roles including senior vice president, global parenteral drug product, delivery devices and regional manufacturing, and vice president, Fegersheim operations. Has 21 years of service with Lilly.
people.quote: Mr. Hernandez has 21 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Carole Ho
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Lilly Neuroscience
people.bio: Before joining Lilly, served as chief medical officer and head of development at Denali Therapeutics Inc. from 2015 to 2025. Her experience also includes leadership roles at Genentech, Inc.
people.quote: Prior to joining Lilly, Ms. Ho served as chief medical officer and head of development at Denali Therapeutics Inc. from 2015 to 2025.

people.name: Patrik Jonsson
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Lilly International
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President and President, Lilly Cardiometabolic Health and Lilly USA, among other Lilly leadership roles. Has 35 years of service with Lilly.
people.quote: Mr. Jonsson has 35 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Lucas Montarce
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Previously served as president and general manager of Lilly's Spain, Portugal, and Greece hub, a position assumed in 2024. Earlier held finance leadership roles at Lilly Research Laboratories, Lilly International, and Elanco Health.
people.quote: Mr. Montarce has 24 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Diogo Rau
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Information and Digital Officer
people.bio: Before joining Lilly, served as senior director of information systems and technology for retail and online stores at Apple Inc. from 2011 to 2021. Previously was a partner at McKinsey & Company.
people.quote: Mr. Rau has five years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Melissa Seymour
people.title: Executive Vice President, Global Quality
people.bio: Before joining Lilly, served as chief quality officer for Bristol Myers Squibb from 2022 to 2024. Previously was chief quality officer at Biogen.
people.quote: Ms. Seymour has two years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Daniel Skovronsky, M.D., Ph.D.
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Scientific and Product Officer and President, Lilly Research Laboratories
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Scientific Officer, and President, Lilly Research Laboratories and Lilly Immunology since 2024. Earlier Lilly roles included chief medical officer, senior vice president, clinical and product development, and vice president, diabetes research.
people.quote: Dr. Skovronsky has 15 years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Jacob Van Naarden
people.title: Executive Vice President, President, Lilly Oncology and Head of Corporate Business Development
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President and President, Lilly Oncology since 2021. Joined Lilly in 2019 through the acquisition of Loxo Oncology, Inc., where he was chief operating officer.
people.quote: Mr. Van Naarden has seven years of service with Lilly.

people.name: Ilya Yuffa
people.title: Executive Vice President and President, Lilly USA and Global Customer Capabilities
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President and President, Lilly International. Earlier roles included senior vice president and president, Lilly Bio-Medicines and vice president of U.S. Diabetes.
people.quote: Mr. Yuffa has held various leadership roles with Lilly, including, most recently, as Executive Vice President and President, Lilly International.

people.bio: Professor of Chemistry at Stanford University and Investigator at Howard Hughes Medical Institute. Joined the board in 2025.
